name: Ribbingsfors ? protected-tree inventory within 250 m of OSM course boundary

provenance.sourceGeometryType: MULTIPOINT (one location per inventory record in selected subset)
provenance.intendedUse: high-value supporting evidence for individually inventoried veteran/protected trees
limitations: Selected records were inventoried in 2005 or 2008; they do not prove that each tree survives in 2026.
The metadata provides no uniform numeric horizontal-accuracy guarantee for individual points.
Reconcile every record against 2023 laser data, 2024 orthophoto and site/control evidence before runtime publication.

selection.distanceReference: planar minimum distance to OSM way 779352687 polygon in EPSG:3006
selection.predicate: distance <= 250 m AND point is inside the full provisional 2048 m LOD0 envelope
